annotation.title_clean: Prioritizing People and Planet as the Metrics for Responsible AI (Ethically Aligned Design for Business)
annotation.title_en: Prioritizing People and Planet as the Metrics for Responsible AI (Ethically Aligned Design for Business)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: IEEE Standards Association – IEEE Global Initiative on Ethics of Autonomous and Intelligent Systems, Ethically Aligned Design for Business Committee
annotation.summary_en: An IEEE SA white paper from the Ethically Aligned Design for Business Committee. It argues that businesses should measure responsible AI with well-being, ESG and UN SDG metrics alongside financial KPIs across the whole AI lifecycle. It sets out an Assess–Apply–Amplify approach and a Well-Being Metrics Readiness Framework. It does not cover robots or other physical AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: Organizations should define 'responsible' at the start of AI design and hold themselves to expanded KPIs that include human well-being and ecological sustainability.
The biggest AI risk is ignoring the needs of people and the planet for the sake of growth, more than bias or a lack of transparency.
Adopts the IEEE 7010-2020 definition of well-being and recommends ESG and UN SDG metrics.
Proposes an Assess, Apply, Amplify process and a Well-Being Metrics Readiness Framework for organizations.
Calls for involving HR, legal, CSR, sustainability, accounting and supply-chain functions.
